changelog:
- Initial release of db-travel: plan rail and public transport journeys across Germany and Europe using the Deutsche Bahn API.
- Supports trip planning, departures/arrivals boards, and station search with real-time info for all major German and cross-border trains, including local transport.
- Easy-to-use Python CLI script; no API key required.
- Provides guidance on summarizing and presenting journey results, including handling delays and relevant modes.
- Includes a list of common German station IDs and supported transport product types.
